localizedValues.name: CBN1
localizedValues.description: These newly constructed, accessible cabins are suitable for up to 5 people with 1 queen bed, 1 set of single bunk beds and 1 single bed. They have leveled entry ways and ramps and include heating, lights and a power outlet (110 volts). Each 200 sq ft cabin has its own private covered patio complete with picnic table and stainless steel cooking surface. Bedding, dishes and cooking stoves are guest supplied. Each cabin rental comes with one assigned passenger-vehicle parking spot. Additional parking spots are not available at this site.
